text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking with Sakura Chiyono
O after
training, we notice Rice Shower
in what seems to
be a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sob... I'm so scared...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing in a place like this,
Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I just went on a run to the shrine, but
when I
stopped to take a break, I
realized that I lost my
phone...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's terrible! We have to look
for it
right away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But the shrine is so dark at night, and
there's no
one around. It's so scary...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It would be pretty scary to go alone...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll go with you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't just leave you here, and I'm sure
you'll feel
better if you have someone
with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and while we're at it, why don't we
run there?
It'll be good training, so think
of it like killing two
birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand she's worried about Rice
Shower, but
she's already run a lot
today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand she's worried about Rice
Shower, but
she's already run a lot
today...
choice_data_list: Make sure to come right back.
I'll come with you, so let's walk.
I'll come with you, so let's walk.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Don't you worry, we'll be back in
a flash!
choice_data_list: Make sure to come right back.
I'll come with you, so let's walk.
I'll come with you, so let's walk.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Can we hold hands when we get to the
shrine?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm not great with spooky stuff
either, so
I'd appreciate that too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite their fears, the two of them set
off for
the shrine at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're coming too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful idea! It won't be scary
at all
with three of us, and going on a
walk together
sounds fun!
choice_data_list: Let's all do a post-workout cooldown together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay. Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a good time strolling to the
shrine as a
group, and we find Rice
Shower's phone waiting
there for us.
